title: [3.1.0.2] problems on small displays with new abbreviation for „days“ and „hours“
symptom: On small displays, using language-specific abbreviations for 'days' and 'hours' causes GUI display issues: when pump is disconnected for 2 hours, it shows only 1 hour and minutes cannot be displayed; also the 'U' for 'units' cannot be displayed.
cause: The problem is caused by the translation, which isn't really a short version in German, leading to display truncation.
fix: For short term solving, switch the language to English.
evidence_quote: For short term solving, I switched the language to english.
